content:
the future is for no one to tell,
but thinking negative will only cast a spell,
which will make you sad,
and forget that the present isn’t so bad!

another one of my instant poems…(mind you…I can only “write” poems, not make them up and speak them on the fly…so I fall into the exclusively writing kind of people)

but the moral here is…you don’t have to worry about some thing so powerful and omnipotent as TIME, because if you think clearly, you’ll find that the only thing that anyone can ever have without paying for it in any kind…the only thing that even violates the conservation of energy principle is TIME…you can have as much as you want, you just need to be smart enough to know where and how much to spend it
